description: A rare total lunar eclipse will occur on March 3–4, 2026, turning the full Moon a striking copper-red colour. Visible across Asia, Australia, and the Americas, this “blood moon” will be the last total lunar eclipse until 2028, making it a must-watch event for skywatchers worldwide.
title: Total Lunar Eclipse 2026: Where and How to See the Rare Blood Moon

description: Here’s a look at some of the best laser printers available in India that offer print, scan, and copy capabilities. The list includes top models from brands like HP, Canon and Brother, along with their key features and prices. Our top picks are  Canon imageCLASS MF643CDW, Canon imageCLASS MF271dn, Brother DCP-L2640DW, HP Laser MFP 1188fnw, HP LaserJet Pro M126nw, and HP 323sdnw.
title: Best All-in-One Laser Printers for Home and Small Businesses

description: iPad Air (2026) with the M4 chipset has been launched in India and other global markets by the Cupertino-based tech giant. On Monday, Apple unveiled the new tablet along with the new low-cost smartphone, iPhone 17e. The new tablet is offered in two screen sizes, 11-inch and 13-inch. Currently on sale in the country via the Apple India online store, the tablet is offered in Blue, Purple, Space Grey, and Starlight colour options. The iPad Air (2026) sports up to a 13-inch Liquid Retina IPS Display with 264 ppi pixel density and up to 600 nits of peak brightness.
title: iPad Air (2026) Launched in India With M4 Chip, Up to 13-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: The iPhone 17e has launched in India and global markets. It upgrades last year’s iPhone 16e with the new A19 chip, MagSafe, and Ceramic Shield protection. It retains a 6.1‑inch 60Hz OLED display and a 48MP rear camera, now starting with 256GB storage. The newly announced iPhone 17e is available in Black, Soft Pink, and White colour options and will go on sale starting March 11.
title: iPhone 17e Launched in India With MagSafe, Ceramic Shield 2 and A19 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Poco has teased the Poco X8 series and Poco C85x 5G on Flipkart, suggesting an imminent India launch. The X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max were recently spotted on certification and benchmark sites, with leaked renders revealing their design. The Pro Max reportedly scored over 36 lakh on AnTuTu. The X8 Pro is tipped to feature a Dimensity 8500 Ultra chip and 6,500mAh battery, while the Pro Max may pack a Dimensity 9500s SoC and 8,500mAh battery.
title: Poco X8 Series, Poco C85x 5G Teased on Flipkart, Could Launch in India in March

description: With Love (2026) is a Tamil romantic drama directed by Madhan, starring Abishan Jeevinth and Anaswara Rajan. The film follows a nostalgic love story built on shared school memories and emotional reconnection. After a successful theatrical run, it is set to premiere on Netflix India on March 6, 2026, in multiple languages, with a strong IMDb rating of 7.6/10 and positive early audience response.
title: With Love OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Open-ear earbuds are gaining popularity in India for offering comfort while keeping users aware of their surroundings. Leading options include the boAt Airdopes Loop, Noise Air Clips, Realme Buds Clip, Nothing Ear Open, and Sony LinkBuds Open. These models feature open or clip-on designs, Bluetooth 5.3 or 5.4 connectivity, low-latency modes, and AI-backed call enhancements. Battery life ranges from 22 to 50 hours, depending on the model, with prices in India starting at Rs. 1,799 and going up to Rs. 17,990.
title: Best Open Earbuds in India: Realme Buds Clip, Nothing Ear Open, Sony LinkBuds Open and More

description: Tecno announced the expansion of its AI-driven product ecosystem at Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 on Monday. At the centre of the showcase is the new Tecno Camon 50 Series, announced as the successor to the Camon 40 lineup. The handsets are powered by the MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate chipset. The brand showcased a range of modular concepts, while also announcing a strategic collaboration with Tonino Lamborghini.
title: MWC 2026: Tecno Camon 50 Series Launched as Firm Unveils Modular Concept Phone, Lamborghini Collaboration

description: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launched Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) in 2004. Initially, the payment settlement was used for interbank transactions. However, the RBI later introduced the service to settle transactions between customer accounts. Another payment settlement system, owned and operated by the RBI, is National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT), which is a nationwide centralised payment system, allowing users to send money of up to Rs .2 lakh. It was launched in 2005.
title: NEFT vs RTGS Key Differences Explained: Transaction Limits, Settlement Time and More

description: Samsung is said to be preparing a new 200-megapixel sensor for 2027 flagship smartphones. The company could unveil an ISOCELL HPA, 200-megapixel sensor with a 1/1.12-inch size next year. This sensor, with support for LOFIC (Lateral Overflow Integration Capacitor) ultra-high dynamic range technology, could be used in Galaxy S27 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra's Successor Tipped to Feature 200-Megapixel ISOCELL HPA Sensor With LOFIC

description: Produced by Praveens Kadiyala and Anil Kadiyala, Vikram on Duty is an upcoming Telugu crime-thriller series that will begin streaming from March 6th, 2026, only on JioHotstar.
title: Vikram on Duty OTT Release Date: Know When and Where to Watch it Online

description: O Romeo, starring Shahid Kapoor, Triptii Dimri, and Avinash Tiwary, is a gritty period crime drama set in post-independence Mumbai. Directed by Vishal Bhardwaj, the film dives into the rise of the underworld and complex human emotions. It will be available for rent on Prime Video from March 27 and is expected to stream for subscribers in April 2026, with an IMDb rating of 5.8/10.
title: O Romeo OTT Release Date Revealed: What You Need to Know About Its Plot, Cast, and More

description: Vanchana is a Tamil-language courtroom crime drama directed by Uma Mahesh. The film revolves around a young man accused of murdering a church father, with all evidence stacked against him. A determined criminal lawyer, Krishna, takes up the case and uncovers unexpected twists and shocking evidence during the investigation.
title: Vanchana OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch This Tamil Courtroom Crime Drama

description: MediaTek on Monday announced that it will unveil a range of next-generation AI and connectivity technologies at its “AI For Life: From Edge to Cloud” showcase during Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026. The keynote presentation, led by President Joe Chen, is slated for March 4, where the company and its partners are expected to present the latest developments in 6G research, 5G-Advanced CPE with Wi-Fi 8, automotive connectivity, flagship smartphone AI, and data centre infrastructure.
title: MediaTek Set to Demonstrate 6G, 5G-Advanced, Edge AI Innovations at ‘AI For Life’ Showcase at MWC 2026

description: Motorola launched the Moto Buds 2 Plus and Moto Buds 2 at MWC 2026 with Dynamic ANC, Hi-Res Audio with LHDC, and Spatial Audio support. The Buds 2 Plus features 11mm drivers with Knowles armatures and Sound by Bose, while the Buds 2 uses dual drivers and ANC up to 55dB. Both offer Bluetooth 6.0, dual connection, and Moto AI features. Motorola claims up to 40 hours of battery on the Plus and 48 hours on the Buds 2.
title: Moto Buds 2 Plus Launched With Dynamic ANC, Sound by Bose Alongside Moto Buds 2 at MWC 2026

description: Ai+ Pulse 2 has been launched in India by the smartphone maker. The handset is scheduled to go on sale in the country on March 11 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart. It is offered in five colour options, dubbed Black, Blue, Green, Pink, and Purple. Moreover, it will be available for purchase in 4GB+64GB and 6GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. The handset is powered by a Unisoc T7250 chipset, which is built on a 12nm process. It also features a dedicated microSD slot with support for storage expansion of up to 1TB.
title: Ai+ Pulse 2 Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Sony announced it was shutting down Bluepoint Games, a studio known for acclaimed remakes and remasters, last month. A new report claims the developer pitched a Bloodborne remake in early 2025, and Sony backed the project. But original developer FromSoftware reportedly rejected the pitch.
title: Bluepoint Games Reportedly Pitched a Bloodborne Remake, but Was Turned Down by FromSoftware

description: Honor unveiled a series of concepts at Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 on Sunday. The China-based company once again demonstrated its highly-awaited robot phone that is built around its Magic V6 foldable, providing more concrete details regarding its features and availability this time around. Honor introduced a humanoid robot prototype as part of its AI push and revealed a new Blade Battery designed specifically for foldable devices.
title: Honor Unveils Humanoid Robot, Blade Battery Tech at MWC 2026; Robot Phone Confirmed to Launch in 2026

description: Lenovo showcased multiple new concept devices on the first day of Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona, Spain. First is a foldable gaming handheld, dubbed Lenovo Legion Go Fold concept, which is claimed to offer seamless transition from a compact gaming device to one with a larger screen. Moreover, the tech giant showcased the Lenovo ThinkBook Modular concept laptop, which will allow users replace the keyboard, display, and I/O ports. On top of this, the company has announced the rollout schedule of its on-device personal ambient intelligence assistant, Lenovo Qira.
title: Lenovo Legion Go Fold Concept Gaming Handheld Showcased at MWC 2026 Alongside New Concept Laptops

description: Lenovo unveiled new AI-focused business devices at MWC 2026, including refreshed ThinkPad T14 Gen 7, T16 Gen 5, T14s Gen 7, and T14s 2-in-1 Gen 2 models, alongside the ThinkPad X13 Detachable, ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Gen 6, and rugged ThinkTab X11. The T-Series runs Windows 11 Pro with Intel, AMD, and Snapdragon options, improved repairability, and optional 5-megapixel cameras. The ThinkBook offers a 360-degree design, while the ThinkTab X11 features Android, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3, and IP68 durability.
title: Lenovo ThinkPad T-Series, X13 Detachable, ThinkTab X11 and ThinkBook 14 2-in-1 Launched at MWC 2026

description: Motorola Razr Fold has been launched during the MWC 2026 alongside the Motorola Edge 70 Fusion. The new foldable smartphone runs on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and has a 6,000mAh battery. The Motorola Edge 70 Fusion runs on a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset and a 5,200mAh battery. The foldable has an 8.1-inch internal display and a 6.6-inch cover screen.
title: Motorola Razr Fold With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC Launched at MWC 2026, Motorola Edge 70 Fusion Tags Along

description: Lenovo launched new Yoga series laptops and tablets at the Mobile World Congress 2026 in Barcelona. The new lineup includes Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition, Yoga Pro 7a, Yoga Slim 7i Aura Edition, IdeaPad Slim 5i Ultra and Legion 7a. They come with the latest Intel and AMD chipsets. The company has also launched the Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 and Legion Tab tablets. The former runs on a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, while the Lenovo Legion Tab generation runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC.
title: MWC 2026: Lenovo Unveils New Yoga, IdeaPad Series Laptop Models Alongside Legion Tab (2026), Idea Tab Pro Gen 2

description: Qualcomm has announced two major connectivity solutions aimed at powering next-generation smartphones and connected devices. The new platforms, dubbed Qualcomm FastConnect 8800 Mobile Connectivity System and the Qualcomm X105 5G Modem-RF System, focus on Wi-Fi 8, Bluetooth 7, proximity-based AI experiences, and AI-powered 5G Advanced connectivity. As per the company, the FastConnect 8800 targets next-generation wireless connectivity across Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB, and Thread.
title: MWC 2026: Qualcomm Unveils FastConnect 8800, X105 5G Modem-RF With Wi-Fi 8; Snapdragon Wear Elite Announced

description: Bharti Airtel has partnered with Google to roll out secure RCS messaging in India to tackle spam and digital fraud. The service, available via the Google Messages app on Android, integrates Airtel’s AI-based spam detection with Google’s RCS platform. Airtel said its systems have blocked 71 billion spam calls and 2.9 billion SMS in 18 months, reducing financial losses by 68.7 percent. The RCS solution adds sender verification, DND enforcement, malicious link filtering, and AI-based spam controls.
title: Airtel Partners With Google to Offer AI-Powered Spam Protection for RCS Messaging in India

description: Sony is reportedly working on a new franchise within the God of War universe. The game will reportedly feature Faye as the protagonist and will be more action heavy. According to an industry insider, the project will be revealed this year and launch in early 2027.
title: Sony Working on New Franchise Within God of War Universe, Will Reportedly Feature Faye as Protagonist

description: Honor Magic V6 debuted at MWC 2026 as a flagship foldable with a 6.52-inch cover and 7.95-inch inner LTPO displays, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip, up to 16GB RAM, and 512GB storage. It packs a 6,660mAh silicon-carbon battery with 80W wired and 66W wireless charging. The phone features a 50-megapixel triple rear camera setup, IP68 and IP69 ratings, and AI tools. It will launch in select markets later this year, with pricing yet to be announced.
title: Honor Magic V6 With 6,600mAh Battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Three Rear Cameras Launched Globally at MWC 2026

description: Motorola Razr Fold will be launched soon as the company's first book-style foldable smartphone. Now, the handset has been spotted on the Geekbench website with Android 16 and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. It is confirmed to have a triple rear camera unit led by a 50-megapixel primary sensor.  It was first showcased at the CES 2026 in January. It will be available in Pantone Blackened Blue and Pantone Lily White colour options.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Makes Surprise Appearance on Geekbench Ahead of MWC 2026 Showcase

description: Nothing Phone 4a series will be launched on March 5. As we wait for the launch, a leak has suggested the possible pricing of the Nothing Phone 4a and Phone 4a Pro. The Nothing Phone 4a could come in three RAM and storage options. It is said to feature a 6.7-inch AMOLED display and a 5,400mAh battery. The Phone 4a is said to come with a starting price tag of Rs. 31,999 for the 8GB RAM + 128GB storage variant.
title: Nothing Phone 4a Series Price in India, Memory Configurations Leaked Ahead of March 5 Launch

description: Tecno Pop X will be launched in India on March 4 at 12 pm IST by the China-based smartphone maker. Additionally, a dedicated microsite for the upcoming handset on Amazon has also been made live to confirm its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The phone is teased to be equipped with a display that refreshes at up to 120Hz. The handset is shown to feature relatively thick bezels. It will be equipped with a single camera unit on the back, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module. The phone will also sport an infrared sensor on the rear panel.
title: Tecno Pop X India Launch Date Announced; Tipped To Arrive as Rebranded Tecno Spark Go 3

description: Xiaomi 17 series, which includes the flagship Xiaomi 17 Ultra and Xiaomi 17, will be launched in India on March 11, along with the Xiaomi Pad 8, the Chinese smartphone maker announced via a social media post. The company announced the India launch date of its new device on February 28, the same day as the global launch of the Xiaomi 17 lineup. The upcoming Xiaomi 17 Ultra and the Xiaomi 17 will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon and the Xiaomi India online store. Both phones will be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Xiaomi 17 Series India Launch Date Announced; Xiaomi Pad 8 to Tag Along

description: Xiaomi Watch 5 has been launched in select global markets, along with the Xiaomi 17 series, Xiaomi Pad 8, and Xiaomi Tag. The new smartwatch and the Xiaomi Tag are now on sale in Spain via the company’s online store. The Xiaomi Watch 5 is offered in two colour options, dubbed Black and Juniper Green. The smartwatch sports a round dial, which houses a 1.54-inch (480x480 pixels) AMOLED display, delivering 312 ppi pixel density and up to 1,500 nits of peak brightness. On the other hand, the Xiaomi Tag allows users to track their belongings while being compatible with Apple Find My and Google Android Find Hub.
title: Xiaomi Watch 5 Launched With 1.54-Inch Display, EMG Sensor Alongside Xiaomi Tag: Price, Features
